For [filters](/docs/shell/commands/categories/filters/).

<div class='command-title'>Converts input to lines.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> lines {flags} ```

## Flags

 -  `--skip-empty, -s`: Skip empty lines.
 -  `--strict`: Validate UTF-8 strictly.


## Input/output types:

| input | output       |
| ----- | ------------ |
| any   | list&lt;string&gt; |
## Examples

Split multi-line string into lines
```nu
> $"two\nlines" | lines
╭───┬───────╮
│ 0 │ two   │
│ 1 │ lines │
╰───┴───────╯

```
